title: The session start hook writes no TMPDIR line on Windows.
ruling: Coordinator ruling, 2026-11-08 00:38 CST: when uname -s starts with MINGW, MSYS or CYGWIN, hooks/session_start.sh writes nothing to CLAUDE_ENV_FILE. Git Bash always has /tmp, the incident (2026-11-07 14:47 CST) was a cloud Linux container, and a written line was wrong on Windows because Git Bash rewrites TMPDIR to its own path form (batch run 1794 had 6 subtests red). The PR body reports the ruling in the lane's words; the coordinator's own words are not in the PR.
quote: Windows writes no line (coordinator ruling, 2026-11-08 00:38 CST): when `uname -s` starts with MINGW, MSYS or CYGWIN, the hook writes nothing. Git Bash always has /tmp, and the incident was a cloud Linux container.
